scope: Original collection, source/content review, structural checks, selected example execution and browser rendering. This is not a proof that every explanation or hypothetical service is correct.
original_preservation: Every published lesson is byte-identical to the downloaded final GPT HTML; revisions were requested from the same GPT, never patched by Codex.
rendering: 390px and 1366px iframe CSS viewport checks in Chrome; not a physical phone test. External original Canvas runtime/CDNs require network access.
limits: AI self-review is not independent factual proof. Official sources and selected executable examples were checked separately.
Actual exam CSV rows and the candidate submitted implementation were not supplied. Full service/worker/crash/performance results are not claimed.
Pseudocode and illustrative simulations are distinguished from executed examples in the per-lesson notes.
